response.justification: Bogdan brings 13+ years of broad, hands-on engineering across web, backend, embedded and low-latency systems, a CS degree, and experience with several of the listed languages, which satisfies the baseline seniority and fundamentals bar. However, the resume shows no evidence of the role's core domain: experimentation frameworks, A/B testing, feature flagging, telemetry/metrics platforms, or statistical analysis and bias detection. His trajectory is that of a strong senior/staff full-stack craftsman at startups and mid-size companies rather than a Principal/IC6 operating across multiple teams at enterprise scale with cross-org influence and measurable growth outcomes. Worth a screening call only if the team is willing to hire for engineering breadth and coach the growth/experimentation domain.
strengths: 13+ years hands-on across many languages and stacks, including C/C++, Java, C#, JS/TS
Real high-throughput, low-latency microservices experience (millions of req/sec at Sociomantic)
Strong engineering-quality culture: TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based dev, tooling, mentoring and teaching
concerns: No demonstrated experimentation, feature-flagging, or growth-measurement platform experience
Little evidence of telemetry/metrics infrastructure, data aptitude, or statistical analysis
Scope and title track (senior/staff at startups) falls short of Principal/IC6 cross-org leadership

key_factors.factor: Depth and breadth of engineering experience
Principal-level scope and cross-team influence not evidenced
